recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆小型成熟淋巴球，核濃縮、細胞質淡藍，在核的左下緣可見一顆單獨、邊界清楚的紫紅色大顆粒；淋巴球出現這種異常巨大的嗜天青顆粒，是 Chediak-Higashi 異常的線索之一，但單一顆粒不具專一性。
features: Small mature lymphocyte with round nucleus and condensed chromatin
Thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Single discrete, round, magenta-purple granule at the lower left nuclear margin, larger than normal azurophilic granules
No other leukocytes available in the field for comparison
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small mature lymphocyte with condensed nuclear chromatin and a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm. A single discrete, round, magenta-purple cytoplasmic granule, larger than typical azurophilic granules, is present at the nuclear margin. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic. In the proper clinical setting (partial oculocutaneous albinism, recurrent pyogenic infections), this giant azurophilic granule is compatible with Chediak-Higashi abnormality; the finding should be confirmed by identifying giant granules in neutrophils and other leukocytes, and LYST mutation testing.

ddx.vs: Has more abundant cytoplasm with several fine to coarse azurophilic granules of normal size, not a single giant granule.
Dense purple mucopolysaccharide granules are present in all leukocyte types, including numerous granules in lymphocytes, rather than one giant granule.
A platelet has a pale hyalomere with a granular center and lies outside the cell border or focal plane.
Occur in dysplastic myeloid cells and blasts of a neoplastic disorder rather than in otherwise normal lymphocytes.
